principle: Freshness limits are set from each source's own observation cadence, not one invented global threshold.

vegetation_feature_timestamp.rationale: flag when more than two composites have been missed

river_feature_timestamp.rationale: flood is a fast-moving hazard; even a 2-day gauge gap is operationally significant

market_feature_timestamp.cadence: WFP market bulletin, roughly monthly with coverage gaps
market_feature_timestamp.rationale: market coverage is already ~31% missing at the source; treated as non-critical (DEGRADED, not INSUFFICIENT)
